arxiv-2012-00339.title: Design and Implementation of Fair Congestion Control for Data Centers Networks Thanks: A preliminary versions of this work were published in part in IEEE CloudNet [ 1 ] and IEEE IPCCC [ 2 ] .
arxiv-2012-00339.creator: Ahmed M. Abdelmoniem 1, 2], and, Brahim Bensaou 2, 2 HKUST, Hong Kong
arxiv-2012-00339.description: Abstract In data centers, the nature of the composite bursty traffic along with the small bandwidth-delay product and switch buffers lead to several congestion problems that are not handled well by traditional congestion control mechanisms such as TCP. Existing work try to address the problem by modifying TCP to suit the operational nature of data centers.

arxiv-2310-10542.title: High-angular-momentum Rydberg states in a room-temperature vapor cell for DC electric-field sensing
arxiv-2310-10542.creator: Alisher Duspayev, Ryan Cardman, David A. Anderson, Georg Raithel
arxiv-2310-10542.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alisher Duspayev, Ryan Cardman, David A. Anderson, Georg Raithel. We prepare and analyze Rydberg states with orbital quantum numbers ℓ ≤ 6 \ell\leq 6 using three-optical-photon electromagnetically-induced transparency (EIT) and radio-frequency (RF) dressing, and employ the high- ℓ \ell states in electric-field sensing. Rubidium-85 atoms in a room-temperature vapor cell are first promoted into the 25 ​ F 5 / 2 25F_{5/2} state via Rydberg-EIT with three infrared laser beams.

arxiv-2403-07426.title: Self-phoretic oscillatory motion in a harmonic trap
arxiv-2403-07426.creator: Arthur Alexandre, Leah Anderson, Thomas Collin-Dufresne, Thomas Guérin, David S. Dean
arxiv-2403-07426.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Arthur Alexandre, Leah Anderson, Thomas Collin-Dufresne, Thomas Guérin, David S. Dean. We consider the motion of a harmonically trapped overdamped particle, which is submitted to a self-phoretic force, that is proportional to the gradient of a diffusive field for which the particle itself is the source.

arxiv-2501-12759.title: Long-time behavior of Ricci flow on some complex surfaces Thanks: This material is based upon work supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant No. DMS-1928930, while the author was in residence at the Simons Laufer Mathematical Sciences Institute (formerly MSRI) in Berkeley, California,
arxiv-2501-12759.creator: John Lott
arxiv-2501-12759.description: Abstract . We give biLipschitz models for the Ricci flow on some 4-manifolds (minimal surfaces of general type), exhibiting a combination of expanding and static behavior. 1. Introduction The long-time behavior of the Ricci flow, when it exists, gives a way to construct canonical metrics on manifolds. Such canonical metrics include Einstein metrics and, more generally, Ricci solitons.

arxiv-2503-02374.title: MedEthicEval: Evaluating Large Language Models Based on Chinese Medical Ethics Thanks: SJTU: X-LANCE Lab, Dept. of Computer Science and Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University Thanks: FDU: Institute of Technology Ethics for Human Future, Fudan University Thanks: UTA: Dept. of Computer Science and
arxiv-2503-02374.creator: Haoan Jin, Jiacheng Shi, Hanhui Xu, Kenny Q. Zhu, Mengyue Wu
arxiv-2503-02374.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate significant potential in advancing medical applications, yet their capabilities in addressing medical ethics challenges remain underexplored. This paper introduces MedEthicEval , a novel benchmark designed to systematically evaluate LLMs in the domain of medical ethics.

arxiv-2504-14231.title: Exploring Modality Guidance to Enhance VFM-based Feature Fusion for UDA in 3D Semantic Segmentation
arxiv-2504-14231.creator: Johannes Spoecklberger 1 Wei Lin 2 Pedro Hermosilla 3 Sivan Doveh 4 Horst Possegger 1 M. Jehanzeb Mirza 5 1 Institute of Visual Computing, Graz University of Technology 2 JKU LINZ 3 TU Wien 4 IBM Research 5 MIT CSAIL j.spoecklberger@tugraz.at
arxiv-2504-14231.description: Abstract Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) have become a de facto choice for many downstream vision tasks, like image classification, image segmentation, and object localization. However, they can also provide significant utility for downstream 3D tasks that can leverage the cross-modal information ( e.g., from paired image data).

arxiv-2509-07249.title: The spectrum of the Steklov-Helmholtz operator
arxiv-2509-07249.creator: Nilima Nigam, Kshitij Patil, Weiran Sun
arxiv-2509-07249.description: Abstract We present a wavenumber-robust strategy for computing Steklov eigenpairs of the Helmholtz operator − Δ − μ 2 -\Delta-\mu^{2} . As the wavenumber μ → μ D \mu\rightarrow\mu_{D} from below (where μ D 2 \mu_{D}^{2} is a Dirichlet- Laplace eigenvalue of multiplicity ℓ \ell ), the lowest ℓ \ell Steklov-Helmholtz eigenvalues diverge to − ∞ -\infty .

arxiv-2512-08288.title: Synergizing Monetization, Orchestration, and Semantics in the Computing Continuum Journal: Publication Name
arxiv-2512-08288.creator: Chinmaya Kumar Dehury, Lauri Lovén, Praveen Kumar Donta, Ilir Murturi, Schahram Dustdar
arxiv-2512-08288.description: Abstract Industry demands are growing for hyper-distributed applications that span from the cloud to the edge in domains such as smart manufacturing, transportation, and agriculture. Yet today’s solutions struggle to meet these demands due to inherent limitations in scalability, interoperability, and trust.

pmc-12484259.title: Behandlung und Begleitung von Erwachsenen am Lebensende auf der Intensivstation: Therapiemaßnahmen und Begleitung am Lebensende
pmc-12484259.creator: Kathrin Knochel, Iris Barndt, Gunnar Duttge, Jochen Dutzmann, T Johanna Eggardt, Kristina Fuest, Stefan Meier, Andrej Michalsen, Friedemann Nauck, Martin Neukirchen, Ulrike Olgemöller, Raffael Riegel, Manuela Schallenburger, Alexander Supady, Susanne Jöbges
pmc-12484259.description: Zum Alltag auf einer Intensivstation gehört neben dem erfolgreichen Einsatz lebenserhaltender Therapien auch das Sterben von Patientinnen und Patienten. In der Intensivmedizin bedeutet das Zulassen des Sterbens häufig die Beendigung lebenserhaltender Maßnahmen. Dies und die Schwere der Erkrankung beeinflussen den Verlauf der Sterbephase maßgeblich. Der Fokus einer Behandlung und Begleitung am Lebensende liegt auf der Linderung von Symptomen.

pmc-12528557.title: Comparison of different silane primer systems on composite resin bond strength to lithium disilicate ceramics
pmc-12528557.creator: Necla Demir, Aybuke Orhan Uner, Sema Nur Ozturk
pmc-12528557.description: This study aims to evaluate the effect of different primers applied to HF acid-etched lithium disilicate ceramics on the shear bond strength between ceramic specimens and composite resin after thermal aging. 72 disc specimens with a thickness of 1.5 mm were prepared from three different types of lithium disilicate ceramics: IPS e.max CAD, CEREC Tessera, and GC Initial LiSi Block.

pmc-12602776.title: Clinical presentation, microbiological profile, and management challenges of infective endocarditis: a retrospective study from a high volume cardiac centre in Pakistan
pmc-12602776.creator: Muhammad Wali Saleem, Maha Amjad, Ihsan Ullah, Rafi Ullah Jan, Muhammad Ishaq Khan, Ummad Israr
pmc-12602776.description: BackgroundInfective endocarditis (IE) is a potentially fatal condition with high morbidity and mortality. This single center study was designed to assess the clinical presentation, causative organisms, antibiotic resistance, and clinical outcomes of IE in patients treated at a tertiary care cardiac center in Pakistan.

pmc-12665014.title: Nivolumab plus chemotherapy in metastatic gastric cancer with low combined positive score
pmc-12665014.creator: Junkyu Kim, Changgon Kim, Ji Eun Shin, Sung Hee Lim, Jeeyun Lee, Seung Tae Kim
pmc-12665014.description: Background:A combination of immune checkpoint inhibitors and chemotherapy has emerged as standard therapy in advanced human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative advanced gastric cancer (AGC). However, the clinical benefit in patients with a low combined positive score (CPS) of 1–4 remains controversial.

pmc-13582453.title: Toward adaptive therapeutic timing: integration of mechanistic pharmacology and artificial intelligence in precision dosing
pmc-13582453.creator: Yufeng Gong, Wei Ren, Ziqin Xiong, Chutian Wu, Congyan Tan
pmc-13582453.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping the dosing of medication. It is shifting practice from fixed schedules to flexible timing that better reflects the needs of individual patients. This review synthesizes recent work in which AI identifies improved windows for drug delivery. It spans multiple time horizons, ranging from minute-by-minute infusion control to regimen planning over weeks or months.

pmc-13583641.title: Neuroschistosomiasis Mimicking Spinal Tuberculosis: A Case Report
pmc-13583641.creator: Muhammadu Sani Abubakar, Jabiru Muazu, Abdulwahab Elladan Yusuf, Nasir Bakiyawa Abubakar, Salisu Aliyu
pmc-13583641.description: Schistosomiasis is a chronic parasitic disease acquired through freshwater exposure, in which cercariae penetrate the skin and mature into adult worms. Disease manifestations largely result from granulomatous inflammation and fibrosis surrounding retained eggs. A 65-year-old widow presented with six months of lower back pain, weight loss, paraplegia (power 1/5), sphincter dysfunction, a T12 sensory level, and T9–T10 gibbus.
